rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for “during that time” in everyday Cantonese.

example.english: I was still living in Mong Kok whilst you were studying abroad.
example.jyutping: go2 zan6 si4 ngo5 zung6 zyu6 hai2 wong6 gok3

rows.note: Use this when “whilst” means “meanwhile” or emphasizes that two things happen at the same time.

example.english: I listened to the radio whilst cooking dinner.
example.traditional: 我一邊煮飯，同時聽住收音機。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 bin1 zyu2 faan6 tung4 si4 ting1 zyu6 sau1 jam1 gei1
